_meta.identityConfidenceReason: Confirmed via operator's own site (goweractivitycentres.co.uk, listing two residential centres at Port Eynon and Rhossili), corroborated by Swansea Council's official page (swansea.gov.uk/goweractivitycentres, which is the operator's local-authority owner), Tourism SwanseaBay, VisitMidWales 'Show Me Wales' listing, and TripAdvisor attraction page (g1644115-d16664538, Swansea County). Phone (01792 390481) and email (gac@swansea.gov.uk) match across the council site and Tourism SwanseaBay.
redFlags: This operator is run by the Local Authority (City & County of Swansea) in partnership with YHA, not a private commercial adventure company -- it is fundamentally a residential/school-group outdoor education centre with day-activity add-ons, which changes tone expectations for the listing.

Operator serves ONLY the Gower Peninsula (two sites: Port Eynon and Rhossili). It does NOT serve pembrokeshire, brecon-beacons, anglesey, llyn-peninsula, mid-wales, or south-wales as a distinct region beyond Gower/Swansea. The combo pages referencing this operator across those 7 regions are incorrect and should be corrected to reference only 'gower' (and optionally 'south-wales' as the broader containing region, since Gower sits within Swansea/South Wales).

Seed website URL (https://www.goweractivitycentres.co.uk) returns a TLS certificate mismatch (cert covers *.secure-secure.co.uk, not the operator's own domain) -- the site is reachable via search-engine cache/plain HTTP but a direct HTTPS fetch fails. Flag for a manual browser check before publishing the link live.
No sourceable Google rating or review count found -- do not display a star rating.

Seed data phone/email were both null; now filled in but should be re-verified by a human call before 'published' status given the council/YHA operating structure and possibility of stale contact info.

proposedOperatorData.name: Gower Activity Centres
proposedOperatorData.tagline: Residential adventure activity centres on the Gower Peninsula, run in partnership with YHA
proposedOperatorData.description:
Gower Activity Centres operates two residential outdoor activity centres on the Gower Peninsula -- Tŷ Borfa (Borfa House) at Port Eynon Bay and Tŷ Rhossili at Rhossili Bay -- run by the City & County of Swansea in partnership with the YHA. For over 40 years the centres have hosted schools, colleges, youth groups and families for residential stays combined with instructor-led outdoor activities, from self-catering weekends to fully catered adventure weeks.

Activities include coasteering, surfing, kayaking, canoeing, rock climbing, abseiling, gorge walking, mountain biking, hill walking, orienteering and team-building, plus beach, woodland and river study sessions and guided heritage walks. Coasteering sessions start from around £45 per person and are tailored to group ability, from school groups to nervous first-timers. Instructors hold National Governing Body qualifications and operate under an AALA (Adventure Activities Licensing Authority) licence.

Both centres offer exclusive-use residential accommodation (32 beds at Port Eynon, 16 beds at Rhossili) with disabled access, on-site parking, WiFi and conference/meeting facilities, making them geared primarily toward group bookings rather than casual walk-in day visitors.
proposedOperatorData.uniqueSellingPoint: One of the few operators combining exclusive-use residential accommodation with instructor-led multi-activity programmes on the Gower coast, purpose-built for school, youth-group and family group bookings.
